data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 木造旧校舍的避雨时光
data.description: 突如其来的骤雨敲打着旧校舍的走廊屋檐。白羽脱下浸湿的草帽抱在胸前，雨水顺着银白的发梢滴落。在狭窄的避雨檐下，两人的肩膀几乎紧紧贴在一起。
data.location: narrow wooden veranda of an antique rustic island school building during downpour
data.action: standing side-by-side sheltered under rain eaves, clutching wet straw hat to chest, blushing deeply as water drips from silvery bangs
data.lighting: cool moody rain ambience with silver reflections splashing off dark wooden floorboards
data.mood: quiet romantic intimacy, summer storm closeness, heart-melting unspoken affection
data.promptProse: Sheltered under wooden school eaves during summer rain, Shiroha clutches her straw hat, standing close with flushed cheeks and dripping white hair.
data.animaCaption: Shiroha sheltering from summer rain under school eaves, blushing in her white dress.
